action_summary: Replace the regressed double-head-only submission with an equal probability blend of X3D and raw-EEG families, averaging every supplied checkpoint within each family. History supports their complementarity, but the exact new blend has not been validated and no score improvement is claimed. Preserve current strict checkpoint-compatible architectures, 0–20 Hz filtering, hemisphere TTA, and X3D time-reversal TTA. Reuse each loaded model for both hemisphere views, apply the equivalent bipolar-chain permutation after filtering to avoid duplicate I/O, halve the X3D batch for memory headroom, and save per-checkpoint/family test predictions. Discover only active checkpoints, convert shell copies to Python, check finite probabilities, normalize submission rows, and retain Kaggle paths and submission.csv. The strategy checklist was applied to this inference-only setting: no training data or OOF predictions are available, so no invented CV, stacking fit, loss tuning, or unvalidated architecture retraining was added.
